sample_unit: clinic notes (50 UCSF test set, 250 Stanford external validation)

links.outcome: Traditional NLP accuracy at external site versus development site
links.effect: On external validation at Stanford (n = 250), tNLP models failed to generalize (61%-62% accuracy) while GPT-4 maintained accuracies >90%.
links.quote: On external validation at Stanford (n = 250), tNLP models failed to generalize (61%-62% accuracy) while GPT-4 maintained accuracies >90%.

links.outcome: Model performance differences by demographics or diagnosis
links.effect: No biases were detected based on demographics or diagnosis.
links.quote: No biases were detected based on demographics or diagnosis.

screen.reason: Retrospective multi-site validation comparing traditional NLP to LLMs for extracting patient-reported outcomes from clinical notes, including an assessment of fairness and error analysis, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
